BiblicalUsage: lᵉʼôm means a community — an ordinary word that carries real weight in the Bible. In Genesis 25:23, "and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels"; and in Genesis 27:29, "and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren". In Isaiah 34:1, "ye nations"; and in Psalms 2:1, "and the people imagine a vain thing?".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is the God of peoples, not just persons — two nations struggled in Rebekah's womb, and every nation answers to Him. I hold that no people is too many or too far for His rule: He summons the nations to hear, and He rebukes the ones that rage. My position is that my people is small in His sight, and that is good news, because He holds it all.
